title: Neon Frost: The Silicon Shroud
premise: In 2088, Tokyo is locked in a perpetual volcanic winter, covered in ash and neon. When Dr. Aris Thorne, the pioneer of 'Ghost-Mapping' (uploading memories into synthetic bodies), disappears from his high-security lab in Akihabara, freelance retrieval specialist Kaelen 'Kai' Reed is hired to find him. The only clues: a fractured memory-drive containing the digital soul of a dead rebel and a bloody message on the lab's glass wall: 'The machine never forgets'.

characters.name: Kaelen 'Kai' Reed
characters.description: An ex-corporate enforcer turned freelance 'memory-hunter'. He has a cybernetic eye that sees data streams but suffers from 'glitch-head'—migraines caused by overwritten memories.

characters.name: Dr. Aris Thorne
characters.description: A visionary neuro-engineer who went rogue. He was rumored to be working on 'Project Lazarus', a way to bring back the consciousness of those lost during the Great Freeze.

characters.name: Unit 7 (Emi)
characters.description: A state-of-the-art android servant found at the crime scene. Her logic core is damaged, and she speaks in poetic riddles, hiding a core memory Dr. Thorne entrusted to her.

characters.name: Sato Ishii
characters.description: The CEO of Kuro-Tech Industries. A transhumanist extremist who believes physical bodies are obsolete and wants Thorne’s research to force a global digital migration.

characters.name: Nova
characters.description: A legendary underground hacker living in the ruins of the old subway tunnels. She specializes in 'data-archaeology' and knows the dark secrets of Kuro-Tech’s server farms.

setting: Neo-Tokyo — 2088. A vertical city of steel and glass where the rich live above the toxic ash clouds in 'Sky-Spires' and the poor survive in the frozen, neon-lit gutters of the Lower Districts.
tone: Gritty, cold, and philosophical. It explores the blurred line between digital immortality and human extinction.
